scope: Bounded one-visit-per-call/width context discovery. Each emitted path is subsequently checked as a literal simple-bin sequence of same-call owner swaps, preserving actual source eligibility and same-call physical-family injection. A search failure does not certify all possible augmenting paths.

complete_first_step_obstruction.proof: Every positive-remainder bin with an outgoing unit swap has remainder1 and supplies width4 or width6. All same-call width5 or width7 donor rows are covered. Every donor bin is initially full, so a first step merely changes remainders(1,0) to(0,1), preserving price. After removing that donor, its untouched slots all have maximal width9. Thus no second unit step can use an untouched slot; no simple remainder-token path with a distinct incoming and outgoing slot can have length at least two.
complete_first_step_obstruction.scope: The proposed same-call one-unit token path, with the incoming changed slot excluded at each interior bin. Multi-item exchanges, multiple interacting tokens, changed clocks, and arbitrary other move families are not excluded.
